The only modern attempt to organise the genus in the Afrotropics defined six species groups and assigned 67 valid species and subspecies to these groups based on qualitative morphology of the worker caste (Fischer et al. 2012).
The new species is described based on qualitative morphology of the worker caste, which we illustrate with high quality coloured focus stacking images and 3D models based on x-ray microtomography.
Major workers of the orange species in the P. pulchella group: P. klaman (A, B CASENT0764691), P. pulchella (C, D CASENT0218336), P. heliosa (E, F CASENT0227946).
The major worker of P. christinae is unknown.
